private mutating func initializeNativeLaunchDisposition(bodyID: Int) {
    let flight = commander.flightSimulation
    guard let index = bodies.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == bodyID }),
      [.cobra, .sidewinder].contains(bodies[index].hull), !bodies[index].navalTarget,
      bodies[index].missionInstanceID == nil, bodies[index].blackjackRole == nil,
      bodies[index].blackjackIdentity == nil,
      var physical = bodies[index].physical, physical.spawnIdentity == nil,
      physical.catalogueShipID == nil, physical.empSource == nil,
      physical.empCrewPod == nil, physical.rock == nil, physical.payload == nil,
      physical.ordnance == nil, physical.salvage == nil,
      physical.identity.system == systemIdentity, physical.identity.visit == flight.visit,
      var npc = physical.npc, npc.routeProvenance == .inferredLocal
    else { return }
    let position = flight.pose.systemPoint(bodies[index].position)
    guard let player = flight.player, let station = flight.anchors?.station.identity,
      let context = gameplayContext(),
      let disposition = AmbientEncounterPolicy.nativeLaunch(
        actor: physical.identity, seed: gameplaySeed,
        government: currentSystem.government, role: npc.role),
      let source = NativeFleetLaunchSource.resolve(
        role: npc.role, actor: physical.identity, seed: gameplaySeed,
        context: context, position: position),
      let stock = NPCResources.stock(source.performance),
      (try? ShipAccommodationProfile(ship: source.ship)) != nil,
      bodies[index].missiles <= source.performance.missiles,
      nativeLaunchGeometryIsSafe(
        source: source, actor: physical.identity, position: position, context: context)
    else {
      bodies.remove(at: index)
      return
    }
    npc.resources = stock
    npc.legal = disposition.legalOverride ?? npc.legal
    npc.legalProvenance = .generated
    npc.cargoProvenance = .generated
    npc.routeProvenance = .generated
    npc.intention = disposition.hostile ? .engage(player) : .dock(station)
    physical.catalogueShipID = source.ship.id
    physical.npc = npc
    var current = bodies[index]
    current.hull = source.ship.nativeHull ?? current.hull
    current.energy = stock.energyCapacity
    current.hostile = disposition.hostile
    current.physical = physical
    guard NPCPersistenceSnapshot.capture(
      body: current, pose: flight.pose, physicalTime: context.physicalTime,
      protection: context.protection) != nil
    else {
      bodies.remove(at: index)
      return
    }
    bodies[index] = current
  }
